name: Haus Helga
beschreibung: The Haus Helga is situated in the sunny district of Sinsen in Kappl in Tyrol's Paznaun Valley, offering an exceptional base for outdoor adventures throughout the year. The alpine-styled rooms feature private bathrooms with shower/WC and sunny balconies with panoramic views across the Paznaun peaks. Each morning, a varied breakfast buffet with local produce prepares guests for active days in the alpine terrain. In winter, the complimentary ski bus stops close by, providing quick transfers to the Kappl ski area and nearby world-famous Ischgl. In summer, high-altitude trails, mountaineering routes, and the valley cycle path entice visitors into nature.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run guesthouse in Kappl in the Paznaun Valley with cosy ensuite rooms, balconies, and easy access to the ski resort.
